BinaryTree API

class core.BinaryTree(n_nodes: int = 0, root: int | None = None, planted: bool = True)[source]

Bases: Tree

Binary tree where each node has at most 2 children.

Maintains explicit left/right child tracking for binary-specific operations. Also stores whether the tree is ‘planted’ (root has degree 1).

__init__(n_nodes: int = 0, root: int | None = None, planted: bool = True)[source]
add_edge(parent: int, child: int, side: str | None = None, length: float = 1.0, **attrs)[source]

Add an edge from parent to child.

Parameters:

  • parent (int) – Parent node index

  • child (int) – Child node index

  • side (str, optional) – ‘left’ or ‘right’. If None, will be determined automatically.

  • length (float) – Edge length

  • **attrs – Additional edge attributes

get_left_child(node: int) → int[source]

Get left child of node. Returns -1 if no left child.

get_right_child(node: int) → int[source]

Get right child of node. Returns -1 if no right child.

is_left_child(node: int) → bool[source]

Check if node is a left child of its parent.

is_right_child(node: int) → bool[source]

Check if node is a right child of its parent.

get_sibling(node: int) → int[source]

Get sibling of node. Returns -1 if no sibling or node is root.

depth_first_search_lr(start: int | None = None) → List[int][source]

Depth-first search with explicit left-right ordering.

Returns nodes in order: leftmost leaf → root → rightmost leaf (standard DFS for binary trees).

get_leaves_lr() → List[int][source]

Get leaves in left-to-right order.

horton_prune() → BinaryTree[source]

Perform one Horton pruning operation.

Removes all leaves and performs series reduction (removes degree-2 nodes).

Returns:

The pruned tree

Return type:

BinaryTree

horton_strahler_order(node: int | None = None) → int[source]

Compute Horton-Strahler order of a node or the entire tree.

Parameters:

node (int, optional) – If provided, return order of this node. If None, return order of the tree.

Returns:

Horton-Strahler order

Return type:

int

validate() → bool[source]

Validate binary tree structure.

Checks Tree constraints plus: - Each node has at most 2 children - Left/right child arrays are consistent with children lists

classmethod from_parent_array(parent_array: ndarray, edge_lengths: ndarray | None = None, left_right_order: List[Tuple[int, str]] | None = None, root: int | None = None, planted: bool = True) → BinaryTree[source]

Create binary tree from parent array.

Parameters:

  • parent_array (np.ndarray) – Parent array where parent_array[i] is parent of node i

  • edge_lengths (np.ndarray, optional) – Edge lengths

  • left_right_order (List[Tuple[int, str]], optional) – List of (node, side) tuples specifying whether each child is ‘left’ or ‘right’. If None, will assign left/right based on index order.

  • root (int, optional) – Root node index

  • planted (bool) – Whether the tree is planted (root has degree 1)

Return type:

BinaryTree instance
